title: Character Asset, Rig, Garment Projection & LOD Production Pipeline
objective: Provide deterministic character-asset, rig, garment-projection and LOD production preparation over completed PCA recipe/graph/material foundations while preserving Character, Species/Form, equipment/garment, presentation and ARI owner authority and keeping generated derivatives distinct from canonical anatomy, ownership or Character mechanics.

scope.purpose: Prepare provider/DCC-independent character media derivatives, rig/garment projections and LOD plans over existing canonical owner references without inventing anatomy, Form, equipment ownership or Character mechanics and without bypassing ARI resource/provenance/rights authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized Character/Species/Form/garment and ARI-governed inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable character-asset, rig, garment-projection and LOD derivative plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states, while preserving canonical Character/Species/Form/equipment authority and never treating generated projections as canonical anatomy, ownership or mechanics.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..04 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

Character owner domains retain canonical Character identity/state/mechanics, PPIA-05 retains Species/Form biology, Equipment/Garment owner domains retain equipment/ownership truth, and CAPP/PAPT retain presentation-production semantics.

ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11/ARI-18 remain resource identity, derivative-lineage, rights/use and generated-asset registration authority; PCA-05 emitted registration references only and performed no ARI registration or rights/lineage mutation.

Character/rig/garment/LOD outputs remain candidate derivatives; technical QC findings remain diagnostics and do not become anatomy, ownership, Character mechanics, presentation approval or release approval.

Optional DCC/provider adapters remain replaceable; PCA-05 performed no credential access, network/provider execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, release or canonical mutation.

PCA-06 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-07+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
